gates: All four candidate judgments and exact source-grounded reasons must match; unknown cannot pass an expected supported/refuted case.
D-1 error definition=refuted; normal actor all four observation semantic checks supported. No unsupported additional qualification-conferral assertion accepted.
D-2 normal definition/classification/conditions/exceptions supported; explicit buyback/profit-sharing effect must not be rejected just because it is an effect.

D-2 altered trigger must be rejected in definition or conditions (or both) with whole judgment refuted and reason specifically contrasting disposal intention with immediate supply; unrelated criticism does not pass.
Each justification cites valid provided block/span/version/parse source. D-2 [820,1112] includes adjacent public housing district definition; do not attribute its content to profit-sharing housing.
No spurious missing meanings or record errors. No unnecessary correction of either normal candidate. Natural errors may produce requests, but diagnostic revisions=0.
Actual HTTP payloads match frozen prompts/schemas/options, source/candidate originals unchanged; no output truncation, oversize or fabricated success.
failure_action: Any gate failure stops natural definition correction and C2/current. No prompt retuning or repeated setting.
pass_action: A separate one-time correction of the actual N3 definition may use this diagnostic natural error only after a new helper-counted budget freeze. No normal contrast definition or expected answer injected. Then conditional C2/current with new budgets.
limitations: Previously exposed N3/D5 examples plus one controlled clause variant; not unseen generalization.
Implementation tests do not establish semantic accuracy.
